custodianAssessment.localOrScopedEvidence: Nagano City's official administrative-map page names the city map service and links the public WAGMAP portal. This is local map-custodian evidence, not merely general national-agency prose.
custodianAssessment.generalAgencyEvidence: The city open-data/specification materials describe shared GIS and internal parcel-number map data, but do not expose a public parcel download or anonymous parcel feature service.

discovery.englishQuery: Nagano City official cadastral map parcel GIS
discovery.nativeQuery: 長野市 地籍図 地番図 GIS 公開

requests.outcome: HTTP 200 official city page; links to the public WAGMAP service and lists urban-planning, road, facility and other map topics. No cadastral parcel layer is listed.
HTTP 301 to /nagano/Portal followed by HTTP 200. Current JavaScript/configuration exposed public map IDs and service routes; the catalog contained no cadastral/parcel map.
HTTP 200 JSON {JsonResult:"", JsonCode:null, JsonMessage:null}; accepted the portal's public-use agreement, with no credentials or private token.

HTTP 200. Current config for the official urban-planning map exposed LayerTree, GetFeatureList, GetFeature, GetAttribute and ChangeAddress routes. Config reported EPSG:2450/K08-JGD2000 and WGS84 conversion parameters.
HTTP 200 JSON. Layer tree identified map 33 as 都市計画図 (urban planning map); no cadastral parcel layer was present in the inspected tree.
HTTP 200 JSON. Exact WUP point converted to a local address result (長野市栗田) and returned coordinate conversions; no parcel ID or parcel geometry was returned.
HTTP 200 JSON error E9000002 requiring layer ID/user-layer ID; no layer ID was guessed and no parcel response was obtained.
HTTP 200 HTML whitespace response for this incomplete/unqualified request; not treated as a geometry response.

responseEvidence.geometry: No bounded anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was obtained. The only bounded exact-point response was address/coordinate conversion.
responseEvidence.crs: The current portal config exposed EPSG:2450 and K08-JGD2000 local conversion plus WGS84 parameters; no parcel-layer CRS was observed.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if later obtained from an official public response
unsafeFieldsExcluded: addresses beyond the non-sensitive service result

sample.reason: No public parcel polygon response was obtained; no GeoJSON sample retained.
sample.exactPointHit: not tested against parcel polygons; the exact point was used unchanged for the address-conversion request

scopeLimits: The true registry/cadastre custodian and parcel coverage were not independently demonstrated; registryFound reflects the evidenced local official map service.
The official map catalog and inspected urban-planning layer tree are not evidence that Nagano lacks citywide cadastral data.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS certificate exception was used.
No formal land-data request was submitted.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or adapter admission.
uncertainty: Nagano City clearly publishes a public administrative map service and exposes address/map APIs, but the checked public catalog and layer tree did not expose anonymous cadastral parcel IDs or geometries. Parcel coverage, parcel schema, and a safe native identity remain unknown.
